geometry.curve: cubic S: control points at (fromX, midY) and (toX, midY); tangents vertical at both ends

algorithmNotes: HEAD first-parent spine is reserved for lane 0. Non-spine commits cannot occupy lane 0.
WIP occupies lane 0 and does not write parent reservations.
A non-spine commit whose first parent is on the spine reserves its own lane until that parent row, then joins lane 0. It does not write lane 0.
A spine commit writes its first parent onto lane 0.
Extra merge parents occupy the lowest free lane >= 1.
Lowest free lane ≥ min grows the array first so a non-spine commit cannot receive index 0.
Freed lanes may be reused by older unassigned commits. Assigned commits never change lane.
Color is laneIndex % 8. Column count may exceed 8; colors wrap.
Rust owns this assignment. Flutter paints the supplied projection only.
Lane colour is lane-(laneIndex % 8 + 1) from tokens/gitlama-tokens.json; lane 0 (HEAD's first-parent spine) is therefore always lane-1 (blue).

shapeRules.commit: hollow ring r=4.5, 2px stroke in the lane colour, filled with the row background
shapeRules.head: filled dot r=4 in the lane colour inside a ring r=7 (1.5px), separated by a 2px row-background gap; applied to the commit HEAD points at
shapeRules.merge: ring r=4.5 with a centre dot r=1.75 (commits with >1 parent)
shapeRules.wip: dashed ring r=4.5 in ink-muted; mixed staging fills the lower half with added-bg; conflicted uses a conflict-coloured dashed ring
shapeRules.stash: dashed ring r=4.5 in the lane colour
shapeRules.graft: ring r=4.5 plus a concentric ring r=7 (type='graft')
shapeRules.replace: ring r=4.5 with a 90-degree arc segment at r=7 (type='replace')
shapeRules.missing-parent: edge stub ending in a 2px hollow dot at the row edge, ink-faint
shapeRules.collapsed-group: pill node on the merge row carrying a Count badge with the hidden commit count
